passages.quote:
Non-statutory guidance to help employers develop and implement flexible working policies and to support employees who want to request flexible working in education settings. It draws on the latest evidence on flexible working, as well as good practice from education settings.

This guidance is for:

employers developing flexible working policies or processing flexible working requests, including:

headteachers

governors

chief executive officers

local governing bodies

trustees

school employees requesting flexible working

local authorities providing human resources advice to maintained schools about flexible working

Read our other resources on flexible working, including case studies.
